judgment.rationale: The submission correctly applies the approved revision-2 record rather than the unapproved Purchase-only proposal: every price change retains Finance, Program and Purchase approval. It also preserves ER/Quality/Purchase TRSO signoff and Finance/Quality/ER/Program nomination signoffs. The workflow covers supplier evaluation, RFQ, negotiation, nomination, evidence retention and controlled post-nomination changes. Its modular quotation structure includes features, design elements, child parts and raw materials, with compatibility rules, deletion credits, separate one-time costs and explicit prevention of double counting. The pricing formula is usable as a first-level configuration model; no unsupported numerical calculations are presented. Scoped change routes reuse unaffected evidence without bypassing required approvals or safety validation. Versioned baselines, revision-linked approvals, audit history, role-based access and implementation gates provide a substantive blueprint for TechSol. Open implementation decisions are explicitly deferred to discovery and pilot validation rather than presented as established facts. The source conflict is resolved by the supplied registry and therefore does not prevent fair scoring.
